CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Megan Kerr, 5th District
Cindy Allen, Vice Mayor, 2nd District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Roberto Uranga, 7th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Al Austin, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District
Thomas B. Modica, City Manager
Monique De La Garza, City Clerk  Rex Richardson, Mayor  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney

  REVISED

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
 The consent calendar shall be heard immediately after the pledge of allegiance, and prior to 6:30
 PM. All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are to be considered routine by the City Council
 and will all be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of said items unless the
 Mayor, City Councilmembers or the City Manager request specific items be discussed and/or
 removed from the Consent Calendar for separate action.

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 14)

 1.  24-54560  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $26,491, offset by the Fourth Council District One-time
  District Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department to provide
  support for the Council District 4 (CD4) end of Summer concerts; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $26,491 to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Daryl Supernaw, Councilman, Fourth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-54573  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $87, offset by $87 of Ninth Council District One-time

  Page 1 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department for the
  liability insurance for Houghton Park Neighborhood Association for the use of the
  Houghton Park Facility; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $87 to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Joni Ricks-Oddie, Councilmember, Ninth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54580  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,350, offset by Fourth Council District One-Time District
  Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to provide
  support for the following:
  1. $250 to Partners of Parks in support of their annual Charity ProAm event;
  2. $600 to Care Closet in support of their ongoing efforts to provide resources
  to the community;
  3. $500 to Friends of Long Beach Animals in support of their 35th annual gala;
  and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,350 to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Daryl Supernaw, Councilman, Fourth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54468  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the City Council meeting of Tuesday,
  August 6, 2024.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54469  Recommendation to refer to City Attorney damage claims received between August
  5, 2024 and August 19, 2024.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 2 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

6.  24-54581  Recommendation to receive and approve Initial Conflict of Interest Code filed, in
  compliance with State law.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-54443  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute a Student
  Internship Partnership Agreement with the Long Beach Community College District
  for a term of five years, with the option to extend, at the discretion of the City
  Manager; and to execute related Work Site Agreements. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Manager; Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-54445  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement No. 35176 with Chicago Title Company, of Los
  Angeles, CA; and Agreement No. 35111 with Ticor Title Company of California, of
  Glendale, CA, for as needed escrow and title services, to increase the aggregate
  contract amount by $100,000, for a revised total aggregate amount not to exceed
  $600,000 and extend the term of the Agreements to May 31, 2025. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-54444  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement No. 35915 with AECOM Technical Services, Inc.,
  of Los Angeles, CA; Agreement No. 35374 with HR&A Advisors, Inc. of Los
  Angeles, CA; Agreement No. 35323 with BAE Urban Economics, of Berkeley, CA;
  Agreement No. 36208 with Jones Lang LaSalle, of El Segundo, CA; and
  Agreement No. 35324 with Keyser Marston Associates, Inc., of Los Angeles, CA,
  for as-needed real estate economic analysis professional services, to increase the
  aggregate contract amount by $500,000, for a revised total aggregate amount not
  to exceed $2,000,000, and extend the term of the Agreements to May 31, 2025.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 24-54446  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute agreements,
  and all necessary documents or subsequent amendments, including amendments

  Page 3 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  to the award amount or terms, with the Los Angeles County Department of Children
  and Family Services to accept and expend grant funding in the amount up to
  $552,786 for the Family Preservation Program, for the period of September 1,
  2024, through June 30, 2025, with the option to extend the agreement for four
  additional one-year periods, at the discretion of the City Manager; and

  Increase appropriations in the Health Fund Group in the Health and Human
  Services Department by $552,786, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 24-54448  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Farm Luck Incorporated, dba
  Taishi Hainan Chicken, for an original application of an Alcoholic Beverage Control
  (ABC) License at 3426 East 4th Street, submit a Public Notice of Protest to ABC;
  and direct City Manager to withdraw the protest if a Conditional Use Permit
  Exemption (CUPEX) is granted. (District 3)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 24-54447  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Contract No. 35886 with Critical Incident Videos Corp., of Fort
  Lauderdale, FL, formerly Critical Incident Videos, LLC, of Vacaville, CA, to provide
  transparency engagement advising services and production services for critical
  incident videos, to increase the annual contract amount by $109,000, for a revised
  annual contract amount not to exceed $144,000, and extend the contract to March
  21, 2025, with the option to renew for one additional one-year period, at the
  discretion of the City Manager. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 24-54452  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an agreement
  and any necessary documents including any necessary subsequent amendments,
  with the Johns Hopkins University to receive and expend grant funding for the Love
  Your Block Program funded by the Bloomberg Philanthropies, in the amount of
  $100,000 for the period of May 1, 2024, to April 30, 2026; and

  Page 4 of 8
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Increase appropriations in the General Services Fund Group in the Technology and
  Innovation Department by $100,000, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Technology and Innovation

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 24-54466  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to allocate Public,
  Education, and Government (PEG) fee revenue equally among the three categories
  of cable access providers, each receiving one-third of the total available; and

  Increase appropriations in the General Services Fund Group in the Technology and
  Innovation Department by $689,349, offset by PEG fee revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Technology and Innovation

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CEREMONIALS AND PRESENTATIONS

 AMERICAN DIABETES ASSOCIATION SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA 2024 STEP OUT WALK
  TO STOP DIABETES

CONTINUED BUDGET HEARING

15. 24-54450  Recommendation to conduct a Budget Hearing to receive and discuss an overview
  of the Proposed Fiscal Year 2025 Budget for the departments of Community
  Development and Library Services. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT: OBTAIN SPEAKER CARD FROM THE CITY CLERK
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

PUBLIC COMMENT: IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO ADJOURNMENT
Opportunity is given to those members of the public who have not addressed the City Council on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes unless extended by the City Council.

STANDING COMMITTEE REMINDER

Tuesday, September 3, 2024 – Hearing for 2515-2545 Atlantic Avenue and 550-572 Vernon
